en: This is where you can\rdesign your own maps!\f
If you need instructions,\rchoose Help from the menu.\f
Help contains control explanations, as\rwell as rules and instructions for\fplaying on the maps you create.\f
cz: Napoveda vysvetluje ovladani a take\rpravidla a postup pro hrani\fna mapach, ktere si vytvoris.\f

en: At least two armies, with an HQ
cz: Aspon dve armady, kazda s HQ

en: and one or more units or factories each.
cz: a aspon jednou jednotkou ci zakladnou.

en: Maps can be used for play in
You must really like doing\rthat over and over.\fKeep it up.\f
cz: Asi te fakt bavi delat\rto porad dokola.\fJen tak dal.\f

en: These blue units are the enemy.\rThey belong to the Blue Moon Army.\f
cz: Tyto modre jednotky jsou nepratelske.\rPatri armade Blue Moon.\f

en: Defeat the enemy forces to\rcomplete this mission successfully.\f
cz: Znicte nepratelske sily a splnite\rtuto misi uspesne.\f

en: Well, let's issue some orders.\fThe cursor is used to give commands.\fThe + Control Pad\rmoves the cursor.\f
cz: Tak pojdme vydat nejake rozkazy.\fRozkazy se zadavaji kurzorem.\fOvladaci krizek\rposouva kurzor.\f

en: No, not there.\fPlace the cursor here\rand press the A Button.\f
cz: Ne, tam ne.\fPresunte kurzor sem\ra stisknete tlacitko A.\f

en: The action you just completed\ris called selecting.\fYou'll see this term often,\rso do your best to remember it.\fWhen you select a unit, the area\raround it will become highlighted.\fThis area represents the selected\runit's range of movement.\fFirst, let's approach\rthe enemy with this unit.\f
cz: Akce, kterou jste prave provedl,\rse nazyva vyber.\fTento pojem uslysite casto,\rtak si ho dobre zapamatujte.\fKdyz vyberete jednotku, okoli\rkolem ni se zvyrazni.\fTato plocha je dosah pohybu\rvybrane jednotky.\fNejprve se timto oddilem\rpriblizme k nepriteli.\f

en: Try moving the unit to this space.\fMove the cursor here and\rpress the A Button.\f
cz: Zkuste presunout jednotku sem.\fPresunte kurzor sem a\rstisknete tlacitko A.\f

en: That's not quite right.\fTry moving the unit again, please.\fPlace the cursor here and\rpress the A Button.\f
cz: To neni uplne spravne.\fZkuste jednotku presunout znovu.\fPresunte kurzor sem a\rstisknete tlacitko A.\f

en: The unit's color changed, right?\fThis indicates that the unit can't\rreceive any more orders this turn.\fDon't worry--you'll be able to use it\ragain on your next turn.\f
cz: Jednotka zmenila barvu, vidite?\fZnamena to, ze uz nemuze v tomto\rtahu prijmout dalsi rozkazy.\fZadny strach, pouzijete ji zas\rv pristim tahu.\f

en: Select this unit, please.\fRemember to press the A Button.\f
cz: Vyberte prosim tuto jednotku.\fNezapomente stisknout tlacitko A.\f

en: Eh? Orange Star Army units have\rmoved into the Alara region?\fHah! They won't last long.\fMy troops there will\rmake short work of them!\f
cz: Co? Jednotky Orange Star vtrhly\rdo oblasti Alara?\fHa! Dlouho tam nevydrzi.\fMoje vojska si s nimi\rporadi raz dva!\f

en: You scored damage on the enemy!\f
What are those fools doing?\fIf I were in the field, they wouldn't\rbe suffering such humiliation!\fCursed Orange Star Army!\rI will defeat it! I will!\f
cz: Co ti hlupaci vyvadeji?\fKdybych tam byl ja, nezazivali by\rtakove ponizeni!\fProklata armado Orange Star!\rPorazim te! Porazim!\f

en: It's your turn again.\fYou have a two-to-one advantage.\fThis battle is yours to win!\fBut, wait a minute.\f
cz: Zase jste na tahu.\fMate prevahu dva na jednoho.\fTuhle bitvu musite vyhrat!\fAle moment.\f

en: This unit took damage in\rthe last battle, didn't it?\fUnits lose some of their\rfirepower when damaged.\f
cz: Tato jednotka utrpela v minulem\rboji poskozeni, ze?\fPoskozene jednotky ztraceji\rcast sve palebne sily.\f

en: This is how the A Button is used\rto select units and issue commands.\fIf you make a mistake and want\rto change orders, use the B Button.\fIt's key that you remember this.\f
cz: Takto se tlacitkem A vybiraji\rjednotky a zadavaji rozkazy.\fKdyz udelate chybu a chcete\rrozkaz zmenit, pouzijte tlacitko B.\fJe dulezite si to zapamatovat.\f

en: You've defeated all\rof the enemy units!\fYour mission is a success!\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Znicil jste vsechny\rnepratelske jednotky!\fMise je uspesna!\fJen tak dal!\f

en: What? Inconceivable!\fThat land was mine! How did\rthey lose it so easily?\fGrrr... Next time,\rvictory will be mine!\f
cz: Coze? Nemozne!\fTa zeme byla moje! Jak ji mohli\rtak snadno ztratit?\fGrrr... Priste\rbude vitezstvi me!\f

en: You know, if you don't move here,\ryou won't be able to attack.\fWould you please move here?\f
cz: Vite, kdyz se nepresunete sem,\rnebudete moci zautocit.\fPresunte se sem, prosim.\f

en: You attacked the enemy\rfrom the mountains, right?\fDefensive cover in the mountains\ris this number here... a four.\f
cz: Zautocil jste na nepritele\rz hor, ze?\fObranne kryti v horach je\rtoto cislo tady... ctyri.\f

en: The defensive cover\ron the plains is a one.\f
Do you know why?\fIt's because of superior defensive\rcover. Remembering this is vital.\fYou should also keep in mind that\rmovement cost differs between units.\f
cz: Vite proc?\fDiky lepsimu obrannemu kryti.\rJe nutne si to pamatovat.\fTake mejte na pameti, ze cena\rpohybu se u jednotek lisi.\f

en: Oh, one more thing.\fIf at any point during the battle you\rneed to stop, there's a way to save.\fSaving will prevent you from having\rto start the same mission over again.\fPlease go to the Map Menu now.\fPlace the cursor on an empty\rspace and press the A Button.\f
cz: Jeste jedna vec.\fKdyz budete potrebovat kdykoli behem\rboje prestat, lze hru ulozit.\fDiky ulozeni nebudete muset zacinat\rstejnou misi znovu od zacatku.\fPrejdete ted do menu mapy.\fUmistete kurzor na prazdne pole\ra stisknete tlacitko A.\f

en: Excuse me, could you please\rdisplay the Map Menu now?\fPress the A Button when the\rcursor's on an empty space.\f
cz: Prominte, mohl byste ted\rotevrit menu mapy?\fStisknete tlacitko A, kdyz je\rkurzor na prazdnem poli.\f

en: You've done it!\fThese units really were\ron a covert operation.\fThanks to your planning, our\rtroops took minimal damage.\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Dokazal jste to!\fTyto jednotky byly opravdu\rna tajne operaci.\fDiky vasemu planu utrpela nase\rvojska minimalni ztraty.\fJen tak dal!\f

en: Aargh! Another failure!\fAfter all of my careful planning,\ranother botched mission!\fGrrr... Next time, I will prevail!\f
cz: Aargh! Dalsi neuspech!\fPo vsem tom peclivem planovani\rzase zpackana mise!\fGrrr... Priste zvitezim ja!\f

en: Move it here using the\rcursor and the A Button.\f
cz: Presunte ji sem kurzorem\ra tlacitkem A.\f

en: Move the unit to this position, please.\f
When you don't have any immediate\rgoals, it's best to move close to cities.\fSo, move to this space, please.\f
cz: Kdyz nemate zadny bezprostredni\rcil, je nejlepsi jit k mestum.\fPresunte se tedy sem, prosim.\f

en: You may lose the battle if you\rforget to finish securing cities.\fAlways start your turn by having\runits complete previous orders.\f
cz: Muzete bitvu prohrat, kdyz\rzapomenete dokoncit obsazovani.\fZacinejte tah vzdy dokoncenim\rpredchozich rozkazu jednotek.\f

en: Now, this city is yours!\fIt's the same color as your troops,\rright? You can now use it as a base.\f
cz: A ted je toto mesto vase!\fMa stejnou barvu jako vase vojska,\rze? Muzete ho pouzit jako zakladnu.\f

en: So, now you can see that\rthese cities are under enemy control.\f
cz: Takze ted vidite, ze tato\rmesta ovlada nepritel.\f

en: By the way, gray\rcities are neutral.\f
Now, here's a problem for you.\f
cz: A ted maly ukol pro vas.\f

en: Yes, that's the correct choice!\fOf course, capturing either one\rof these cities is a plus for you.\fBut if you secure the enemy city,\ryou also reduce your foe's funds.\f
cz: Ano, to je spravna volba!\fObsazeni kteryhokoli z techto\rmest je pro vas samozrejme plus.\fKdyz ale obsadite mesto nepritele,\rsnizite mu take finance.\f

en: Oh, yes. There's one more thing\ryou need to know.\f
cz: Ach ano. Jeste jednu vec\rmusite vedet.\f

en: Outstanding!\fYou've reclaimed the area and\rforced Blue Moon to withdraw!\fThere's one more thing\rI have to tell you.\fYou receive funds by\rcapturing cities, right?\fWell, once you clear a map,\ryou lose those funds. Sorry!\fGood luck on the next battle!\f
cz: Vyborne!\fDobyl jste oblast zpet a donutil\rBlue Moon k ustupu!\fJeste jednu vec vam\rmusim rict.\fZa obsazovani mest\rdostavate finance, ze?\fJenze jakmile dokoncite mapu,\ro tyto finance prijdete. Pardon!\fHodne stesti v dalsi bitve!\f

en: Oh, no!\rYou've been defeated...\fRegroup and try again.\rGood luck!\f
cz: Ale ne!\rByl jste porazen...\fSeradte se a zkuste to znovu.\rHodne stesti!\f

en: Olaf has his bases covered.\fIt looks like he understands the\rimportance of holding this area.\fAlmost all of our units heading for\rLost Fortress have been eliminated.\f
cz: Olaf ma zakladny dobre kryte.\fVypada to, ze chape, jak dulezite\rje tuto oblast udrzet.\fTemer vsechny nase jednotky mirici\rk Lost Fortress byly znicene.\f

en: To repair a unit, just move it to an\rallied city or a secure base.\f
cz: Opravu jednotky provedete tak, ze ji\rpresunete do sveho mesta ci zakladny.\f

en: If you don't move the unit into a city,\rit won't regain any HP.\fWould you move it here, please?\f
cz: Kdyz jednotku nepresunete do mesta,\rnedoplni si zadne HP.\fPresunete ji sem, prosim?\f

en: If you leave it out there next\rto the enemy, it's done for.\fLet's move it to a safe place.\f
cz: Kdyz ji tam nechate vedle\rnepritele, je s ni konec.\fPresuneme ji na bezpecne misto.\f

en: I'd like to repair this unit now, but\rthere's no safe place within\fits movement range. There's\rnothing we can do about that.\fLet's get it as close to a city as\rpossible and begin repairs next turn.\f
cz: Rad bych tu jednotku opravil, ale\rv jejim dosahu pohybu neni\fzadne bezpecne misto. S tim\rnic nenadelame.\fDostanme ji co nejbliz k mestu\ra opravu zacneme pristi tah.\f

en: Would you move it here, please?\f
I'm sorry for the confusion.\fWould you please move the unit here?\f
cz: Omlouvam se za zmatek.\fPresunete tu jednotku sem, prosim?\f

en: That's right. Thank you.\fBut we can't stop there, can we?\f
cz: Presne tak. Dekuji.\fAle tim to nekonci, ze?\f

en: Well, what to do now? How about\rgiving it a little assistance?\fLet's deploy other units around it to\rprevent it from being attacked.\fThis tactic is called building\ra defensive wall.\fOur available units are...\f
cz: Co ted? Co takhle ji trochu\rpomoct?\fRozmistime kolem ni dalsi jednotky,\raby na ni nepritel nedosahl.\fTato taktika se nazyva stavba\robranne zdi.\fK dispozici mame tyto jednotky...\f

en: Move it here to create\ra defensive wall.\f
cz: Presunte ji sem a vytvorte\robrannou zed.\f

en: At this point, our goal is to\rprotect this unit.\f
cz: Nasim cilem je ted ochranit\rtuto jednotku.\f

en: So, we need to block the enemy's\rapproach with one of our other units.\f
cz: Musime tedy zablokovat pristup\rnepriteli jinou nasi jednotkou.\f

en: There! Now the unit is safe\rfrom enemy attack.\fEnemy units can't cross allied\rlines and vice-versa.\fYou can see why a defensive wall is\rsuch an effective strategic tool.\f
cz: A je to! Jednotka je ted v bezpeci\rpred utokem nepritele.\fNepratelske jednotky nemohou projit\rnasimi radami a naopak.\fVidite, proc je obranna zed tak\rucinny takticky nastroj.\f
